senses.def: the brightness that comes from the sun, a fire, or a lamp and lets us see
senses.ex: The light in this room is soft.

senses.def: an object that gives brightness, such as a lamp
senses.ex: Please turn on the light.

senses.def: not heavy; easy to lift or carry
senses.ex: This box is light.

senses.def: pale in color
senses.ex: She wears a light blue coat.

senses.def: to make something start to burn or to give light to a place
senses.ex: He lights a candle at night.

phrases.def: to become bright, or to make something bright
phrases.ex: Her face lights up when she laughs.

phrases.def: a light at a road crossing that tells cars when to go or stop
phrases.ex: The car stops at the red traffic light.

senses.def: to move fast on your feet
senses.ex: The children run in the park.

senses.def: to control and be responsible for a business or a group
senses.ex: Her family runs a small shop.

senses.def: to work or to make a machine work
senses.ex: The engine runs all night.

senses.def: a period of running, or a journey made by a vehicle
senses.ex: I go for a run before work.

phrases.def: to have none of something left
phrases.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.

phrases.def: to hit someone or something by accident, or to meet someone by chance
phrases.ex: I ran into an old friend on the street.

senses.def: the top part of the body with the eyes, ears, nose, and mouth
senses.ex: She shakes her head.

senses.def: the mind, where we think and remember
senses.ex: A good idea came into my head.

senses.def: the person who leads a group, school, or company
senses.ex: He is the head of the school.

senses.def: to go in a direction or toward a place
senses.ex: We head for the station.

phrases.def: to move toward a place or a result
phrases.ex: The ship heads for the port.

phrases.def: to stay calm when things are difficult
phrases.ex: Keep your head and call for help.

senses.def: true or correct
senses.ex: You gave the right answer.

senses.def: on the side where most people write
senses.ex: My right hand is hurt.

senses.def: something that the law says a person may do or have
senses.ex: Every child has the right to learn.

senses.def: exactly, or without delay
senses.ex: The keys are right on the table.

senses.def: to have a meaning; to show or express an idea
senses.ex: What does this word mean?

senses.def: to intend to say or do something
senses.ex: I mean to finish today.

senses.def: unkind, or not willing to share or spend
senses.ex: Do not be mean to your sister.

phrases.def: to plan or intend to do something
phrases.ex: I mean to call you later.

senses.def: continuing up to now, or in spite of that
senses.ex: It is late, but she is still working.

senses.def: not moving; calm and quiet
senses.ex: The water of the lake is still.

senses.def: even more than before
senses.ex: The night grew still darker.

phrases.def: a painting of things that do not move, such as fruit or flowers
phrases.ex: She paints a still life of apples.

senses.def: a place where people keep and borrow money
senses.ex: I put my money in the bank.

senses.def: the ground along the side of a river
senses.ex: We sit on the bank of the river.

senses.def: a store of something that people can use
senses.ex: The hospital keeps a blood bank.

phrases.ex: Do not bank on good weather tomorrow.

phrases.def: a bank that keeps people's savings
phrases.ex: She opens an account at the savings bank.

senses.def: an idea or the most important part of what someone says
senses.ex: That is a good point.

senses.def: a sharp end, or a small mark or place
senses.ex: The pencil has a fine point.

senses.def: a unit that counts a score or a mark
senses.ex: Our team won by three points.

senses.def: to show where something is by holding out your finger
senses.ex: She points at the map.

phrases.def: to say or show something that others may not have seen
the way one person sees a matter
phrases.ex: From my point of view, the plan is good.

senses.def: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
senses.ex: The food is on the table.

senses.def: a set of facts or numbers shown in rows
senses.ex: The table shows the price of each item.

senses.def: the group of people sitting at a table
senses.ex: The whole table laughs at the joke.

phrases.def: having a meal at a table
to change a situation so that you now have the advantage
phrases.ex: The second goal turned the tables.

senses.def: the season after winter, when plants begin to grow
senses.ex: Flowers come out in spring.

senses.def: a curved piece of metal that returns to its shape after you press it
senses.ex: The bed has soft springs.

senses.def: a place where water comes up from the ground
senses.ex: The village gets water from a spring.

senses.def: to jump up suddenly
senses.ex: The cat springs onto the wall.

phrases.ex: New shops spring up in the town.

phrases.def: a place where warm water comes up from the ground
phrases.ex: They bathe in a hot spring.
